name: Lindsey Tenaglia
introduction: My name is Lindsey Tenaglia! As a native Californian hailing from a small town in the Bay Area, I fostered my love for the act of telling any and every story in all shapes and forms. I mostly work with digital programs such as Toon Boom Storyboard Pro and Adobe Photoshop, but conceptually, I don’t like to stray too far away from a pen and paper to jot down ideas or little beat boards right in the moment of an idea being born. I am interested in the meat of the story, its context, small details and moments, and subtle worldbuilding. I love creating worlds and characters for a viewer to get invested in within a couple of shots. I want to give people reasons to ask questions and leave them wondering what could happen next. But mostly, I want to get people thinking with my storyboards, which is why I take care in the writing processes of things just as much as the drawing sides of things. Both need to flow congruently for a story to truly take form for an audience to connect and comprehend it.
